_doc: Instruments the gates must NOT propose, for any lane or format. This is a HARD filter applied before cooldown. Edit this file to bench or un-bench — do not hard-code benches in tooling. Read by tools/recommend_slot.py (and any other gate that proposes instruments).
_why_this_file_exists: 2026-08-02: fixing the track_record duration bug flipped Dilruba x anxiety from FLOP to MODEST, and it immediately became the #1 recommendation for BOTH Thu Aug 6 and Fri Aug 7. Dilruba had been benched by the user on 2026-07-25, but the bench lived only in SESSION_CONTEXT and memory - no tool enforced it. It was caught by hand. A bench that only exists in prose will eventually ship a video.

benched.reason: Every tried cell is a FLOP - morning n=3 median 671 views, anxiety n=2 median 1,048. Its only apparent win was the unrepeatable May-9 surge windfall, and the music audit showed that video actually carried Santoor audio, not Dilruba.
benched.unbench_condition: Explicit user say-so plus a fresh hypothesis. Do not propose it even as an off-list experimental arm.
benched.note: After the 2026-08-02 track_record duration fix its verdict reads MODEST (n=3, med 1,922v). The bench is a USER DECISION and overrides the gate verdict.

benched.reason: Production block, not a performance verdict: content-violation flags on renders (first surfaced 2026-08-07 for 3hr, confirmed channel-wide by the user 2026-09-05 and again 2026-09-12). Removing the instrument from the TITLE does not clear it - Content ID matches audio fingerprints, not metadata.
benched.unbench_condition: User confirms renders clear. Bansuri's track record is NOT the reason for this bench - Bansuri x sleep x 3hr is the channel's only PROVEN cell (n=6, median 5,638 engaged), so un-bench as soon as production allows.
